control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
alarm, muster and accounting for people

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at P-4101 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control MUSTER_AND_ACCOUNTING: the alarm, muster and accounting for people was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the alarm, muster and accounting for people on P-4101, M-4101 and TT-4101 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining fire protection systems, specifically maintaining portable and mobile extinguishing equipment. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 12 January 2009 an incident occurred on P-4101, M-4101 and TT-4101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
